item.title: threexui
item.description:
Architecture

The architecture source is one diagram with three separate sections: overview, control plane, and data plane. It describes maintained architecture, not live inventory or service health. Bazel renders light and dark SVGs.

The overview shows Master in the Control Plane hierarchy and full node hostnames in provider groups, with Vault, Let’s Encrypt, and Mullvad as external services. Overview links attach to the Control Plane and Data plane boundaries. The control-plane section expands the 3x-ui VM’s Traefik and panel with one simple data-plane node. The data-plane section expands one node’s Traefik, 3x-ui, and Xray with one simple control-plane endpoint; njalla1, work1, and yc1 share this implementation.
